summary: A 1937 L-4 cab on a 25-ft timber tower at Lookout Mountain near Twisp, staffed until 1997, now on standby; trail access is public, tower climbing is unconfirmed.

facts.design: L-4 cab, 14 x 14 ft with catwalk, on a 25 ft timber tower
facts.status_note: Standing, but on standby since 1998 and not staffed full-time.

access.note: The trail and summit are reached from a no-fee trailhead at the end of Alder Creek Road. No source found says whether the tower itself may be climbed; ask the Methow Valley Ranger District first.

visit.trail_note: About 2.6 miles round trip, climbing about 1,000 feet to the ridge, from the trailhead at the end of Alder Creek Road.

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Okanogan-Wenatchee National Forest (Methow Valley Ranger District)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Sources agree the present L-4 cab was built in 1937. They disagree on earlier structures: a 1922 standard tower on a log cabin (Forest Lookouts), a 1928 planned 14 x 14 ft house (Forest Lookouts) and a 1931 log cupola (National Historic Lookout Register). The story uses 1937 for the present cab and marks the earlier dates as disputed.
The register and Firelookout.com give the timber tower as 25 ft. WTA says the tower rises a further 60 feet. The record uses the 25 ft figure, which two sources share.
The register dates the volunteer cabin repaint to June 2022. The TrailChick article is headed June 24, 2022, but describes an August painting effort, so the year of the painting is not settled.
The Forest Service trailhead page gives the drive as Forest Road 1605-250, while the trail page gives 4400-200 for the same road. The story gives no road number.

notes_for_editor: Build history is disputed for the years before 1937 (1916 camp, 1922 tower on a log cabin, 1928 planned house, 1931 cupola). Staffing as_of 2022 comes from TrailChick's description of on-call status; Firelookout.com is undated and says emergency status. Tower climbing is not addressed by any source reached, so access is public for the trail and summit only. The 25 ft height is from the register and Firelookout.com; WTA's 60 ft figure is unexplained. The repaint year is uncertain (register June 2022; TrailChick August painting in a post headed June 2022). Trailhead road numbers differ between two Forest Service pages. The 1943 Aircraft Warning Service dates come from the Forest Lookouts site only, though the register confirms the service.
